arms.label: L9 mixer, whole output
arms.what: The L9 mixer's whole output is swapped. The clean texts are run with the output of the L9 mixer replaced.

arms.label: L9 mixer, head 10 only
arms.what: Only head 10's read is swapped. The clean texts are run with the output of the L9 mixer replaced.

arms.label: resid_post.8, whole, through the L9 mixer
arms.what: All of resid_post.8 is swapped. The change is added to resid_post.8 and sent through the model's own L9 mixer only; the residual's direct path stays clean.
